Container.Name: minecraft-server
Container.Overview: Vanilla Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server. On every start it downloads Mojang's current Linux BDS zip (same release as Minecraft for Windows). Configure the world, allow list, difficulty, and ports from this Unraid form. Live admin console: Docker Console → mc-console. UDP 19132 only — not Java Edition.
Container.Description: Bedrock Dedicated Server aligned with Minecraft for Windows. Copy a world into appdata/minecraft-server/worlds/<Level Name>/ and allowlist.json next to it. Leave Allow List Users empty if you copied a file. Clients use UDP 19132. Admin console: Docker → Console → mc-console (detach with Ctrl-b then d).

Config.Name: World Data
Config.Description: Persistent data: worlds/, allowlist.json, server.properties, cached BDS zips. Copy an existing world into worlds/<Level Name>/

Config.Name: Game Port IPv4
Config.Description: Bedrock game port (UDP). Windows / consoles / phones use this.

Config.Name: Game Port IPv6
Config.Description: Bedrock IPv6 game port (UDP)

Config.Name: EULA
Config.Description: Must be TRUE. You accept https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA

Config.Name: Version
Config.Description: LATEST = current Minecraft for Windows. PREVIEW = beta app. Or pin a BDS id such as 1.26.51.1

Config.Name: Transport
Config.Description: raknet = classic UDP 19132 (same as a working old BDS). nethernet = new WebRTC transport; needs TCP 19132 plus extra UDP ports.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the friends / LAN list

Config.Name: Level Name
Config.Description: World folder name under worlds/. Must match the folder you copied (default: Bedrock level)

Config.Name: Gamemode
Config.Description: survival, creative, or adventure

Config.Name: Difficulty
Config.Description: peaceful, easy, normal, or hard

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Maximum connected players

Config.Name: Online Mode
Config.Description: true = Xbox Live / Microsoft accounts (required for Minecraft for Windows)

Config.Name: Enable Allow List
Config.Description: true = only players in allowlist.json (or Allow List Users) can join

Config.Name: Allow List Users
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated gamertags. LEAVE EMPTY if you copied allowlist.json — this field overwrites that file on start.

Config.Name: Level Seed
Config.Description: Used only when generating a brand-new world

Config.Name: Allow Cheats
Config.Description: true enables /op and cheat commands

Config.Name: View Distance
Config.Description: Chunks sent to clients. Empty = BDS default.

Config.Name: Tick Distance
Config.Description: Simulation distance. Empty = BDS default.

Config.Name: Default Permission
Config.Description: visitor, member, or operator. Empty = BDS default (member).

Config.Name: Ops (XUID)
Config.Description: Comma-separated Xbox XUIDs written to permissions.json as operators. Leave empty if you copied permissions.json.

Config.Name: Backup on Upgrade
Config.Description: Copy worlds/ aside when Mojang ships a new BDS zip

Config.Name: Keep Backups
Config.Description: Number of upgrade backups to keep

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: File owner UID (Unraid nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: File owner GID (Unraid users)
